buy(address[],address,uint256,uint256,ui.details: Allows a user to buy assets by transferring payment tokens and receiving the assets.

params.assets: The addresses of the assets to be bought.
params.assetsReceiver: The address that will receive the bought assets.
params.deadline: The deadline timestamp for the purchase.
params.epochId: Id of the epoch to buy from, will revert if not the current epoch
params.maxPaymentTokenAmount: The maximum amount of payment tokens the user is willing to spend.

returns.paymentAmount: The amount of payment tokens transferred for the purchase.

constructor.details: Initializes the FeeFlowController contract with the specified parameters.

params.epochPeriod_: The duration of each epoch period.
params.evc: The address of the Ethereum Vault Connector (EVC) contract.
params.initPrice: The initial price for the first epoch.
params.minInitPrice_: The minimum allowed initial price for an epoch.
params.paymentReceiver_: The address of the payment receiver.
params.paymentToken_: The address of the payment token.
params.priceMultiplier_: The multiplier for adjusting the price from one epoch to the next.

returns._0: price The current price calculated based on the elapsed time and the initial price.

getSlot0().details: Retrieves Slot0 as a memory struct

returns._0: Slot0 The Slot0 value as a Slot0 struct

buy(address[],address,uint256,uint256,ui.notice: This function performs various checks and transfers the payment tokens to the payment receiver. It also transfers the assets to the assets receiver and sets up a new auction with an updated initial price.

constructor.notice: This constructor performs parameter validation and sets the initial values for the contract.

getPrice().notice: Uses the internal function `getPriceFromCache` to calculate the current price.
